record.question: Which of the following personalities are conferred with the National Florence Nightingale Awards 2020 for their meritorious service by President of India, Shri Ram Nath Kovind on 15 th September, 2021?
record.explanation: Vanlalthuami and C. Dengthangpuii were the two Mizoram recipients of the National Florence Nightingale Awards 2020 conferred on 15 September 2021. The contemporary report identifies the latter as a retired Health Supervisor and the former as a health worker: https://www.indiatodayne.in/breaking-news/story/national-florence-nightingale-awards-412563-2021-09-16
